name: finova
description: Finova - Full-Stack Digital Banking & Investment Platform

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.setup-db: cd server && node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const pool = require('./db/pool'); const fs = require('fs'); const sql = fs.readFileSync('./db/init.sql','utf8'); pool.query(sql).then(()=>{console.log('Tables created');process.exit(0)}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"
